<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Nest Trigger and Content under Root and put Items inside Content. Single mode uses a string value and multiple mode uses an array. Supply value and label pairs in Root.items to show the label for an initial or externally assigned value while the menu is closed.

## Usage

```ts
import { select, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/select';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/select`. It [registers](../../registration/) 12 components for use in JSON.

### Example View

Register the `select` set and pass this JSON as `view` to `renderer.mount`.

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "region",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Select.Root",
    "inputs": {
      "type": "single",
      "value": "seoul",
      "items": [
        {
          "value": "seoul",
          "label": "Seoul"
        },
        {
          "value": "busan",
          "label": "Busan"
        }
      ]
    },
    "slots": {
      "default": [
        {
          "id": "trigger",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Select.Trigger",
          "inputs": {
            "aria-label": "Region"
          },
          "slots": {
            "default": [
              {
                "id": "value",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Select.Value"
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "content",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Select.Content",
          "slots": {
            "default": [
              {
                "id": "seoul",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Select.Item",
                "inputs": {
                  "value": "seoul",
                  "label": "Seoul",
                  "text": "Seoul"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "busan",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Select.Item",
                "inputs": {
                  "value": "busan",
                  "label": "Busan",
                  "text": "Busan"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

The trigger starts with “Seoul”. Open it and choose “Busan” to update the selection.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-select-root"></a>

### `shadcn.Select.Root`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.Select`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"single" \| "multiple"` | **Required** |
| `open` | `boolean` | Default `false` |
| `allowDeselect` | `boolean` |  |
| `autocomplete` | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `items` | `Array<{ disabled?: boolean, label: string, value: string }>` | `[]` no extra fields |
| `loop` | `boolean` |  |
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |
| `scrollAlignment` | `"center" \| "nearest"` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |
| `value` | `string \| Array<string>` |  |

<details>
<summary>Additional HTML and ARIA inputs</summary>

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-disabled` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-icon` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-invalid` | `string \| boolean` |  |

</details>

Slots `default`.

| `openChangeComplete` | `boolean` | — |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
